subject: kea
title: A Parrot Missing Half Its Beak Won Every Fight and Became Boss

scenes.text: This parrot lost half his beak. Now he's the boss.
Bruce is a kea from New Zealand. His whole upper beak is missing.
So he fights like a knight, charging rivals and stabbing with his lower beak.
He won every dominance fight scientists recorded against other males.
Other males even clean his beak. His stress hormones? Lowest in the group.
No disabled animal was known to reach the top alone like this. Half a beak. Still the boss.

description:
Bruce, a kea at Willowbank Wildlife Reserve in New Zealand, is missing his entire upper beak, yet he is the alpha male of his group.
He jousts by charging or lunging and striking rivals with his lower beak, attacks with his beak more than five times as often as other males and was undefeated in recorded dominance interactions. Subordinate males preen his beak, and his stress hormone levels were the lowest of his peers.
What other animal has turned a handicap into a weapon?
first_comment: Bruce's jousts pushed rivals away 73 percent of the time, his kicks only 48. Would you bet against him?
